description: Election Commission - Subasinghe Gamachchige Dulmi Kaushalya Kulathunga was selected as the member of the Kaduwela Municipal Council - Muthukutti Kankanamge Ajith Prasanna was Selected as the member of the Kotapola Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in local government councils (Kaduwela Municipal Council and Kotapola Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of elected members to fill seats that became vacant due to party membership changes. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral procedures and declarations rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
